wording: After routing overhead is included, CRR will reduce inference cost at one or more matched quality levels relative to the best fixed-model strategy.
falsifier: No matched quality level has lower total CRR cost, or the apparent gain disappears when routing cost is charged.

wording: Uncertainty-triggered escalation will recover difficult cases while avoiding strong-model inference on every item.
falsifier: Escalation either fails to recover quality or routes nearly all items to the strongest route.

wording: The potential benefit of routing increases with measurable disagreement in model rankings across capability regions.
falsifier: Routing benefit is unrelated to rank disagreement, or the relationship vanishes under held-out model/task sets.
